entries.test: Whether public reports or social-media posts of Gemini 3 errors and embarrassing outputs appeared within hours of its 18 November 2025 announcement.
entries.note: 'Usual' is framing. The testable core is whether error reports appeared quickly.

entries.test: Whether, as of November 2025, Gemini 3 matched or beat OpenAI's best model on major public benchmarks and leaderboards such as LMArena, Humanity's Last Exam and ARC-AGI.
entries.note: 'Basically squandered' is loose wording. The plain reading is that Google has reached parity or better at the frontier.

entries.test: Whether, after Google makes TPUs commercially available at scale and a reasonable price, Nvidia's data-centre accelerator market share falls sharply and GPU and compute prices drop through price competition.
entries.note: It has three consequents and no deadline. Whether the antecedent has been met (broad commercial TPU availability at scale) is itself a matter of judgement.
